selection_order: top three lexical spans within that envelope for first read
remainder of the envelope when evidence is insufficient
one additional session by recent eligible turn activity plus one by visible-message lexical overlap
ranked spans in that neighboring-session pool for prioritization, followed by its full causal 72-hour turns if still insufficient
neighbor_scope: all local Codex session origins, including voice and projectless; direct source turns must precede the record minute plus one minute
non_operational_oracle_warning: The experiment uses gold citations to report the first complete stage. A deployed system would need curator feedback or another validated sufficiency check to decide when to expand; no such automatic semantic stop is implemented.
held_out_policy: Do not change selection/ranking parameters in response to the 20 held-out labels; report misses and source-lineage overlap as limitations.
